requirements_summary: Workloads: in-app chat assistant (multi-turn), semantic search embeddings, reranking pipeline.
Latency SLO: chat p95 <= 150ms; embeddings batch latency <= 600ms.
Traffic forecast: baseline 40 QPS steady, expected peak 220 QPS during marketing campaigns.
Concurrency target: 60 concurrent chat sessions; avg session ~8 requests, KV cache reuse expected.
Token mix: generation requests avg 700 input+output tokens, embeddings ~256 tokens per vector request; estimated token mix 65% generation, 35% embeddings.
Throughput need: 200–250 QPS for gen paths; embeddings batch sizes 16–64.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — want committed discount for Dedicated vs hosted at scale.
Routing/fallback: prefer same API, auto-fallback to hosted in cross-region outage.
Data residency: EU customer data must remain in eu-west region for EU customers.
poc_results: Hosted API trial: 14 days, 1.2M tokens consumed, avg latency gen p50=80ms p95=140ms.
Observed KV/cache hit rate ~52% reduces average token compute by ~20%.
Peak observed concurrent KV sessions 48 during spikes.
Embeddings throughput measured: 350 vectors/sec on single batch node; batch size 32 optimal.
notes: AE note: very product-led, engineering team of 12 working on AI features (quote: 'latency is what sells to our customers').
SE note: Asked for a Dedicated sizing template with QPS->GPU mapping; prefers A100-style equivalence.
Finance: wants committed 12mo with 20–25% uplift over hosted price for predictability.
Legal: standard NDA inbound; vendor security review scheduled 2025-02-10.
Quote from CTO on 2025-01-30: 'If rollout keeps p95 <150ms, we'll go dedicated and commit 1yr.'
